[[UC Senior Secondary College Lake Ginninderra|Lake Ginninderra]] ([[Canberra]], [[Australian Capital Territory|ACT]]) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = | letter = | bbr = | nba_profile = }} '''Dante Exum''' (born July 13, 1995) is an Australian [[basketball]] player. He is considered one of the best prospects for the [[2014 NBA draft]].[http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/nba/news/20130926/nba-draft-big-board-2014-andrew-wiggins/ 2014 NBA Big Board: Wiggins leads deepest draft in years][http://insider.espn.go.com/nbadraft/results/top100/_/year/2014 Chad Ford's Top 100 - 2014] ==Junior career== Exum played for the Keilor Basketball Association as a junior[http://www.heraldsun.com.au/leader/west/former-keilor-thunder-basketballer-dante-exum-is-shooting-for-nba-selection/story-fngnvog3-1226763186781 Former Keilor Thunder basketballer Dante Exum is shooting for NBA selection] and attended [[UC Senior Secondary College Lake Ginninderra|Lake Ginninderra Secondary College]] in Canberra where, in conjunction with, also attended the [[Australian Institute of Sport]]. In April 2013, Exum participated in the 2013 Nike Hoop Summit for the World Select Team where he recorded 16 points, 3 rebounds and 2 assists in a 112-98 win over the USA Junior Select Team.[http://www.draftexpress.com/article/2013-Nike-Hoop-Summit-Game-Recap-4149/ 2013 Nike Hoop Summit Game Recap][http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MtrJ3kWJVz0 4.20.2013 - Nike Hoops Summit] In October 2013, he graduated from Lake Ginninderra and had the option to enroll in college and play [[college basketball]] during the [[2013–14 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2013–14 season]], but he decided against it.[http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/9609453/dante-exum-enroll-college-december Dante Exum undecided on college] Exum competed in the Australian National High School Basketball Championships held between December 2013 and January 2014, going on to lead [[UC Senior Secondary College Lake Ginninderra|his team]] to the eventual title.[http://www.heraldsun.com.au/sport/basketball/australian-young-gun-dante-exum-focus-of-attention-at-australian-school-champs/story-fni2u9cl-1226773638407 Australian young gun Dante Exum focus of attention at Australian School Champs][http://www.heraldsun.com.au/sport/basketball/australian-teen-dante-exum-set-for-nba-draft/story-fni2u9cl-1226812549917 Australian teen Dante Exum set for NBA draft] On January 28, 2014, it was announced that Exum signed with agents from Landmark Sports and that he will declare for the 2014 NBA draft.[http://espn.go.com/nba/draft2014/story/_/id/10363177/dante-exum-declares-2014-nba-draft Dante Exum declares for draft] ==International career== Exum played for Australia in the 2012 [[FIBA Under-17 World Championship]] and the 2013 [[FIBA Under-19 World Championship]].[http://www.grantland.com/blog/the-triangle/post/_/id/68170/dante-exum-the-fiba-u19-world-championships-and-the-purest-form-of-nba-draft-nerddom Dante Exum, the FIBA U19 World Championships, and the Purest Form of NBA Draft Nerddom] Exum averaged 18.2 points and 3.8 assists over nine games at the 2013 FIBA U19 tournament, subsequently being named to the All-Tournament Team. He was also selected in the 2013 Boomers FIBA Oceania Championship squad where he played sparingly in both games against New Zealand. ==Personal== Exum was born in the [[Melbourne]] suburb of [[East Melbourne, Victoria|East Melbourne]] to American parents. His father, [[Cecil Exum|Cecil]], played college basketball at the [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|University of North Carolina]] and won an NCAA championship in 1982, a team which featured Michael Jordan and James Worthy. His mother also attended North Carolina. Cecil was drafted in [[1984 NBA Draft|1984]] by the [[Denver Nuggets]] of the NBA, and later settled in Australia where he played in the [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] for the [[North Melbourne Giants]], [[Melbourne Tigers]] and [[Geelong Supercats]].[http://www.heraldsun.com.au/news/victoria/national-basketball-association-scouts-from-us-chasing-local-teenager-dante-exum/story-fni0fit3-1226690760452 National Basketball Association scouts from US chasing local teenager Dante Exum][http://bluestarmedia.org/index.php/component/k2/item/510-dick-weiss-on-australia%E2%80%99s-dante-exum Dick Weiss on Australia’s Dante Exum] ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * [http://www.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/player/p/pid/88598/pid2//sid/9616/tid/239/tid2//_/2013_FIBA_U19_Championship_for_Men/index.html FIBA.com Profile] {{Australia Squad 2013 FIBA Oceania Championship}} {{Persondata | NAME = Exum, Dante | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = Australian basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = July 13, 1995 | PLACE OF BIRTH = Melbourne, Victoria | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Exum, Dante}} [[Category:1995 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Australian basketball players]] [[Category:Australian expatriate basketball people in the United States]] [[Category:Australian Institute of Sport basketball players]] [[Category:Australian people of American descent]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Melbourne]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Shooting guards]]
